semiconductor_relevance: High — Wooptix specializes in advanced wafer metrology solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wooptix is a semiconductor wafer metrology innovator that provides high-speed, high-accuracy in-line measurements using its proprietary wavefront phase imaging technology. Their systems enable comprehensive characterization of silicon wafers, enhancing yield and quality control for chip manufacturers.

regional_presence.Asia: Wooptix is actively deploying solutions at various customer sites across Asia.
regional_presence.Europe: Wooptix has a presence in Europe, providing its metrology solutions to local semiconductor manufacturers.
regional_presence.North America: The company is also engaged with customers in North America, enhancing their manufacturing processes.
